comparisons.peer_topic: AI Software Ecosystem and Silo AI Acquisition
comparisons.peer_summary: To support its AI strategy, AMD consolidated AI teams to develop a comprehensive software ecosystem, improved AMD ROCm software performance, and acquired Silo AI Oy to accelerate AI model development and deployment on AMD hardware, leveraging Silo's software stack for training large language models.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AMD disclosed specific strategic actions to advance their AI capabilities in the Data Center in fiscal 2024, though they targeted different layers of the stack. NVDA focused on launching AI inference platforms combining software with specific processors (Ada, Hopper, Grace Hopper) and introducing cloud services (DGX Cloud) for generative AI and LLMs. AMD similarly focused on its AI software ecosystem by consolidating AI teams, optimizing its ROCm software for generative AI workloads, and acquiring Silo AI to accelerate the training of LLMs on its Instinct accelerators. While NVDA highlighted inference platforms and cloud services, AMD emphasized software ecosystem consolidation and acquisition for training capabilities, reflecting a parallel industry focus on building comprehensive full-stack AI solutions (hardware + software/services) for generative AI.

sentences.text: In Data Center, we launched AI inference platforms that combine our full-stack inference software with NVIDIA Ada, NVIDIA Hopper and NVIDIA Grace Hopper processors optimized for generative AI, LLMs and other AI workloads.
We introduced NVIDIA DGX Cloud and AI Foundations to help businesses create and operate custom large language models and generative AI models.
To execute our AI strategy, we brought together multiple AI teams across AMD to drive development of a comprehensive software ecosystem spanning our full product portfolio.

We made several key optimizations and introduced new features in the latest AMD ROCm™ software that increased performance in key generative AI workloads, expanded support and optimization for additional frameworks and libraries, and simplified the overall developer experience.
We also made strategic investments to further expand our AI software capabilities with the acquisition of Silo AI Oy (Silo AI), an AI lab based in Finland.
